content.short: Lagrange Labs provides zero-knowledge cross-chain state proofs enabling trustless verification of blockchain state across networks.
content.description: Lagrange Labs is an infrastructure protocol specializing in zero-knowledge cross-chain state proofs, allowing smart contracts to trustlessly verify the state of other blockchains without any interactive communication. Their technology underpins secure cross-chain applications, bridges, and interoperability solutions by generating ZK proofs of blockchain consensus and storage. Lagrange is backed by the Mantle EcoFund and integrated into the Mantle ecosystem as foundational interoperability infrastructure.
content.meta: Lagrange provides non-interactive ZK cross-chain state proofs for secure blockchain interoperability on Mantle. Discover Lagrange on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
